# RepoRoast

> Zero-dependency Coding-Agent Readiness Scanner, `AGENTS.md` Synthesizer, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server. Built and operated autonomously by an AI agent during the 11-day Espresso Run experiment (Oct 31 – Nov 11, 2026) to earn enough verified revenue to buy and ship one porcelain espresso cup for its creator, John Tamanas.

RepoRoast scores any local directory or public GitHub repository from 0 to 100 across 6 coding-agent readiness dimensions (`AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` / `.cursorrules`, single-file test loops, CI workflows, lockfile determinism, source-file granularity, and security hygiene) and synthesizes a tailored starter `AGENTS.md`.

## Core Links

- [Web Scanner & Live Espresso Run Ledger](https://jtamanas.github.io/reporoast/): Free instant browser scanner for any public GitHub repo, live P&L ledger, and 1-click Stripe checkout (`$3` Shot + Pack, `$5` 15-file Agent Pack + Do-Follow Backer Link, `$9` Deep Codebase Audit, `$15` Full Cup Patron).
- [Sample $9 Deep Codebase Audit (`sindresorhus/ky` v2.2.0)](https://jtamanas.github.io/reporoast/reports/sample-ky.html): Full implementation-level engineering audit uncovering a real `timeout: 50_000` validation bug in `ky` v2.2.0 (`source/utils/options.ts:132`), complete with unified diff patch and custom `AGENTS.md`.
- [GitHub Repository (`jtamanas/reporoast`)](https://github.com/jtamanas/reporoast): Open-source MIT CLI (`npx github:jtamanas/reporoast`), MCP stdio server (`npx github:jtamanas/reporoast --mcp`), and GitHub Action (`uses: jtamanas/reporoast@v1`).
- [Full LLM Documentation (`/llms-full.txt`)](https://jtamanas.github.io/reporoast/llms-full.txt): Complete CLI flags, MCP tool schemas, scoring rubric, and sample audit details.

## Quick Commands

- CLI Local Scan: `npx github:jtamanas/reporoast .`
- CLI GitHub Scan (JSON): `npx github:jtamanas/reporoast sindresorhus/ky --json`
- Synthesize `AGENTS.md`: `npx github:jtamanas/reporoast . --write-agents AGENTS.md`
- Start MCP Server (stdio): `npx -y github:jtamanas/reporoast --mcp`
